correctness.rationale: For ordinary paperfolding p(i) determined by odd part mod 4, P_k=p(1)...p(2^k), k≥6, the word has odd number 2^(k−1)+1 of ones hence all cyclic rotations distinct. Explicit parity-indexed sixteen-symbol macroblocks K_e(x), whose type counts are (r,r,r−1,r+1), yield 28 seven-factor classes by a complete 64-case enumeration. 24 classes have fixed predecessor bit; two mixed classes sort by 8th bit, third by 8th and 16th bits, final 1101100 class by recursively comparing shorter paperfolding rotations, with B_6=1011 and B_j=A_j B_(j−1). Thus exactly eighteen explicit consecutive BWT blocks and count 4k−4 runs. Independently generated p and lexicographically sorted every literal cyclic rotation for k=6..9, reproducing the entire exact 18-block predicted string, not merely run counts; finite instances corroborate but induction handles arbitrary k.
residual_risks: Only sentinel-free circular transform of the complete dyadic prefixes k≥6, not arbitrary prefixes or sentinel-terminated BWT.
The lone recursive sorting class must preserve cyclic wrap-around and exact parity splits; examined proof handles last macro p(m)=1 and a separate k=6 base.
